name: WW1 default tree
note: Seeded into a campaign when game mode starts. year = when the tech becomes researchable (minus the campaign's research lead). rp = research points, money paid when the project starts. Everything dated on or before the start year is unlocked at the start.

techs.name: Magazine rifles
techs.desc: Bolt-action magazine rifles for every infantryman.

techs.name: Machine-gun companies
techs.desc: Belt-fed machine guns organised into companies.

techs.name: Field entrenchment
techs.desc: Infantry dig in as a matter of routine: +1 trench cover.

techs.name: Concrete pillboxes
techs.desc: Reinforced-concrete machine-gun posts: the MG bunker emplacement.

techs.name: Hand grenades
techs.desc: Stick and Mills bombs for trench fighting: infantry attack +1.

techs.name: Trench mortars
techs.desc: Light mortars that drop bombs into the opposite trench.

techs.name: Light machine guns
techs.desc: Lewis and Chauchat guns move with the squad: infantry attack and defend +1.

techs.name: Steel helmets
techs.desc: Adrian, Brodie and Stahlhelm: infantry defend +1.

techs.name: Infiltration tactics
techs.desc: Small assault groups bypass strongpoints: Assault Regiments can be raised.

techs.name: Combined arms
techs.desc: Infantry, guns, tanks and aircraft attack as one: infantry and mobile attack +1.

techs.name: Mountain warfare
techs.desc: Alpine and mountain regiments.

techs.name: Naval infantry
techs.desc: Marines trained to land from the sea.

techs.name: Cyclist battalions
techs.desc: Infantry on bicycles for quick road moves.

techs.name: Quick-firing field guns
techs.desc: Recoil-absorbing field guns like the French 75.

techs.name: Horse artillery
techs.desc: Light batteries that keep up with cavalry.

techs.name: Heavy howitzers
techs.desc: 150 mm and 6-inch howitzers for the corps.

techs.name: Siege artillery
techs.desc: Big Berthas and Škoda mortars that crack fortresses.

techs.name: Indirect fire control
techs.desc: Observers and telephones: artillery range +1.

techs.name: Creeping barrage
techs.desc: The barrage walks ahead of the infantry: artillery attack +2.

techs.name: Railway guns
techs.desc: Naval-calibre guns on rail mounts.

techs.name: Sound ranging and flash spotting
techs.desc: Enemy batteries are located by their sound: artillery attack +1, range +1.

techs.name: Anti-aircraft guns
techs.desc: High-angle mounts for shooting at aircraft.

techs.name: Fixed anti-aircraft defences
techs.desc: Permanent gun positions round towns and depots: the AA emplacement.

techs.name: Coastal batteries
techs.desc: Fixed guns covering harbours.

techs.name: Gas shells
techs.desc: Chemical rounds fired by ordinary guns: artillery attack +1.

techs.name: Armoured cars
techs.desc: Machine guns on armoured motor chassis.

techs.name: Armoured trains
techs.desc: Guns and armour on rolling stock.

techs.name: Tracked vehicles
techs.desc: Caterpillar tracks carry weight across broken ground.

techs.name: Landships (Mark I tanks)
techs.desc: The first tanks: Tank Battalions can be raised.

techs.name: Light tanks
techs.desc: Renault FT: tanks move +1 and cost 20% less.

techs.name: Massed tank tactics
techs.desc: Cambrai: tanks attack +2.

techs.name: Motor transport
techs.desc: Lorries replace horses behind the front: support and artillery move +1.

techs.name: Observation balloons
techs.desc: Tethered balloons spot for the guns.

techs.name: Rigid airships
techs.desc: Zeppelins for reconnaissance and bombing.

techs.name: Reconnaissance aircraft
techs.desc: Two-seaters that watch the enemy's rear.

techs.name: Aerial photography
techs.desc: Cameras in the observer's seat map the enemy's lines: aircraft see 100 km further under fog of war.

techs.name: Seaplanes
techs.desc: Floatplanes for coastal patrol.

techs.name: Synchronised machine guns
techs.desc: Firing through the propeller: Fighter Squadrons can be formed.

techs.name: Bomber aircraft
techs.desc: Purpose-built bombers.

techs.name: Strategic bombing
techs.desc: Gothas and Handley Pages: bombers attack +2, range +2.

techs.name: Fighter tactics
techs.desc: Circuses and formations: fighters attack +2, defend +1.

techs.name: Naval aviation
techs.desc: Ships that carry and recover aircraft.

techs.name: Aircraft mass production
techs.desc: Aircraft cost 25% less and build one turn faster.

techs.name: Pre-dreadnought battleships
techs.desc: Mixed-battery battleships.

techs.name: Torpedo boats
techs.desc: Small fast boats with torpedoes.

techs.name: Torpedo-boat destroyers
techs.desc: Fast escorts to hunt torpedo boats.

techs.name: Dreadnoughts
techs.desc: All-big-gun turbine battleships.

techs.name: Battlecruisers
techs.desc: Battleship guns on a cruiser's hull.

techs.name: Submarines
techs.desc: Diesel-electric boats.

techs.name: Unrestricted submarine warfare
techs.desc: Sink on sight: submarines attack +3.

techs.name: Depth charges and hydrophones
techs.desc: Escorts fight back: destroyers attack +2.

techs.name: Convoy system
techs.desc: Merchantmen sail escorted: transports defend +4.

techs.name: Minelaying
techs.desc: Moored contact mines and the ships that lay and sweep them.

techs.name: Naval fire control
techs.desc: Rangefinders and directors: ships range +1.

techs.name: Oil-fired boilers
techs.desc: Oil replaces coal in the fleet: ships move +1.

techs.name: Shipyard expansion
techs.desc: Ships build one turn faster.

techs.name: River gunboats and monitors
techs.desc: Shallow-draught gun platforms.

techs.name: Chlorine gas
techs.desc: Cloud gas released from cylinders: Gas Companies can be raised.

techs.name: Gas masks
techs.desc: Respirators for every soldier: infantry defend +1.

techs.name: Phosgene
techs.desc: A deadlier agent: gas companies attack +2.

techs.name: Mustard gas
techs.desc: Persistent blister agent: gas companies attack +2 more.

techs.name: Haber–Bosch process
techs.desc: Nitrogen fixed from the air: nothing needs Chilean nitrates any more.

techs.name: Explosives industry
techs.desc: TNT and cordite plants: artillery costs 15% less.

techs.name: Railway troops
techs.desc: Units that build and run military railways.

techs.name: Field telephones
techs.desc: Wire links between headquarters and the front.

techs.name: Wireless telegraphy
techs.desc: Ships and headquarters talk by radio: naval attack +1, +2 research per turn.

techs.name: War economy
techs.desc: Industry turned to war: money income +15%, every city builds one more unit at a time.

techs.name: Mass production
techs.desc: Assembly lines: everything costs 20% less money.

techs.name: Medical services
techs.desc: Field hospitals: units below full strength recover 5% a turn.

techs.name: Motorised supply
techs.desc: Lorried supply keeps the infantry moving: infantry move +1.

techs.name: Labour corps
techs.desc: Organised labour battalions: +2 manpower per turn.

techs.name: War loans
techs.desc: Bonds sold to the public: +15 money per turn.

techs.name: Synthetic rubber
techs.desc: Methyl rubber from coal: nothing needs plantation rubber.

techs.name: General staff system
techs.desc: A professional staff plans and directs the army.

techs.name: Universal conscription
techs.desc: Every young man serves: Conscript Regiments, +3 manpower per turn.

techs.name: Reserve and territorial system
techs.desc: Trained reservists on call: Militia Regiments, 20% cheaper.

techs.name: Colonial levies
techs.desc: Regiments raised in the colonies.

techs.name: Cavalry reform
techs.desc: Cavalry as mounted riflemen as well as shock.

techs.name: Military mining
techs.desc: Tunnelling and pioneer companies.

techs.name: Total war
techs.desc: The whole nation mobilised: manpower +25%, infantry 15% cheaper.

techs.name: Defence in depth
techs.desc: Elastic zones instead of a single line: infantry defend +1, trench cover +1.

techs.name: Stormtrooper tactics
techs.desc: Hutier tactics perfected: Assault Regiments attack +2.

techs.name: Air–ground cooperation
techs.desc: Contact patrols and aerial spotting: air and artillery attack +1.

techs.name: Distant blockade
techs.desc: The fleet in being: ships defend +1.

techs.name: Industrial statistics
techs.desc: Ministries count what the country makes and where it goes: money income +4%. Opens the Economy branch.

techs.name: Municipal improvement boards
techs.desc: Towns plan their own roads, water and housing: developing a town costs 15% less and takes a turn less.

techs.name: Standardised machine tools
techs.desc: Interchangeable jigs and gauges: upgrading a factory costs 15% less and takes a turn less.

techs.name: National savings movement
techs.desc: Savings certificates and war bonds sold street by street: money income +5%.

techs.name: Scientific management
techs.desc: Time-and-motion study on the shop floor: money income +4%, research +5%.

techs.name: Grid electrification
techs.desc: Power stations feed whole regions: money income +6%; town development and factory upgrades cost 10% less.

techs.name: Reconstruction finance
techs.desc: Long-term credit for rebuilding and new industry: money income +6%, manpower +5%.
